hec.script

Class ScriptManagerImpl

  • java.lang.Object
    • hec.script.ScriptManagerImpl
  • All Implemented Interfaces:
    ScriptConstants, ScriptManager

    public class ScriptManagerImpl
extends java.lang.Object
implements ScriptManager, ScriptConstants
    Class for managing the storing and retrieving of scripts. possible places for storing scripts are: .../CWMS/All/scripts .../CWMS//scripts at some point these locations will also be supported: ...//All/scripts ...///scripts
    Author:
    Mark Ackerman, RMA
